description:
Create a note in the NotebookLM Studio panel.

Notes are user-created annotations that appear in your notebook. Use them to save research findings, summaries, key insights, or any custom content you want to keep alongside your sources.

Notes support markdown formatting for rich text content.

content.description: Content/body of the note. Supports markdown formatting.

notebook_url.description: Notebook URL. If not provided, uses the active notebook.

session_id.description: Session ID to reuse an existing session

name: note_create

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
